optimizerOutputs.acceptedText: Fix `mergeConfig(defaults, overrides = {})` in `config.mjs` without changing its named export or the public tests. Require both arguments to be non-null, non-array plain objects, otherwise throw `TypeError`. Consider only own enumerable string keys, ignoring inherited keys, and treat keys like `__proto__` and `constructor` as ordinary data keys, including from `JSON.parse`. Each value must be a primitive (`string`, `number`, `boolean`, or `null`) or a one-level nested plain object of primitives. Merge top-level keys with overrides winning; when both values are nested objects, merge their own immediate fields while preserving default fields absent from the override; otherwise replace with the override, including `false`, `0`, and `null`. Return a fresh top-level object and fresh nested objects, never mutating or retaining nested references from either argument, and keep calls independent, including repeated calls with the same defaults.
